<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Nature's Edge](/Classes.aspx?ID=9)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 166

**Class** Ranger
</column>

---

You always find the weak points in your foes' defenses when they're on unfavorable terrain. Enemies are [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) to you if they're in natural difficult terrain or in difficult terrain resulting from a [snare](/Equipment.aspx?Category=31).
name: Nature's Edge
